about: Contact sheets per kind (hero: hero candidates and allowlisted images; featured: featured candidates; cards: the card of each project) and provider, Korean projects first. Tile lines: #n and image id; provider and the original width x height; S sharpness B blockiness T tier V visual, then OK (approved), R? (needs an approve_image after review) or H? (hero candidate, needs hero.json/set_hero); the project id; the project name in ASCII. index.json maps every tile to its project, image id, file or source URL.
